description: Safely inspect authorized software and asset packages with pinned REA evidence, then translate findings into original MGR-native build specifications and tests.

defaultPrompt: Inspect this legally accessible kit, show what it contains and what we can build MGR-native.
Compare the package to our Forge components and find missing implementation and tests.
Audit source permissions before suggesting a production import.
interface.longDescription: Read-only inspection of user-authorized local asset and software packages with pinned REA 6.8.0. Preserves source evidence and helps author independent MGR-native implementation and verification plans. Local REA runtime required for tools.

name: mgr-rea-xray
